x=iter([1,2])
y=next(x)
z=[i for i in x]

record Count:
    value:int
    fn next(mut self)->int:
        return self.value
x=Count(3)
y=[n for n in x]

record Empty:
    value:int
x=Empty(3)
y=[n for n in x]

record Items:
    value:int
    fn iter(self)->list[int]:
        return [self.value]
x=[n for n in Items(3)]
